# Feodotracker Review Dashboard
Explores third-party IP indicator rows ingested from [abuse.ch Feodotracker](https://feodotracker.abuse.ch/) through the CCF Push connector. Feed matches require freshness and contextual validation before response.

**Table:** `FeodoTracker_CL`

content.query:
FeodoTracker_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Indicators = dcount(ip_address) by malware, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| render timechart
content.title: Feed Indicator Timeline

content.query:
FeodoTracker_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where status == "online"
| summarize C2Servers = dcount(ip_address) by country
| sort by C2Servers desc
| take 15
| render barchart
content.title: Geographic Distribution

content.query:
FeodoTracker_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where status == "online"
| summarize OnlineFeedIPs = dcount(ip_address), LatestFeedObservation = max(last_seen), Countries = make_set(country, 5) by malware
| sort by OnlineFeedIPs desc
content.title: Online Feed IPs by Malware Label

content.query:
FeodoTracker_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| project TimeGenerated, ip_address, port, malware, status, country, first_seen, last_seen
| take 50
content.title: Recent Indicators

content.query:
let FeedIPs = FeodoTracker_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where status == "online"
| distinct ip_address, malware;
union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, SourceIP:string, DestinationIP:string, LogSource:string)[]),
    (CommonSecurityLog | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where isnotempty(DestinationIP) | project TimeGenerated, SourceIP, DestinationIP, LogSource = DeviceProduct),
    (DnsEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where isnotempty(IPAddresses) | mv-expand IPAddress = split(IPAddresses, ",") | project TimeGenerated, SourceIP = ClientIP, DestinationIP = tostring(IPAddress), LogSource = "DNS")
| join kind=inner FeedIPs on $left.DestinationIP == $right.ip_address
| project TimeGenerated, SourceIP, DestinationIP, malware, LogSource
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Network Log Matches to Feed IPs (Triage Only)
